title: Kestrel Logistics Rate Card — Exchange Replacement Shipping Fee for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rate rule.** On an exchange replacement order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, the exchange replacement shipping fee is the band fee of the shipping band that the full transfer distance falls in, reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded half up to the cent. The shipping bands run from the first band, for distances up to the first band limit, through the second and third bands, for distances up to the second and third band limits, to the fourth band, for distances above the third band limit. No exchange replacement shipping fee is owed when the transfer distance is no more than the program's free transfer distance or when the program waives the exchange shipping fee.

**Band schedule.**

| Band | Transfer distance | Band limit | Band fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| First | up to 500 miles | 500 miles | $499.00 |
| Second | above 500, up to 1000 miles | 1000 miles | $799.00 |
| Third | above 1000, up to 1500 miles | 1500 miles | $1099.00 |
| Fourth | above 1500 miles | none | $1490.00 |

**Terms used.**
- *Transfer distance*: the transport distance from the hub holding the vehicle to the buyer's market, as recorded on the replacement order.
- *Program's shipping fee discount, free transfer distance and exchange shipping waiver*: the figures of the replacement vehicle's program in the program shipping terms.
- *Reduced by the discount*: the band fee less the discount percentage of that band fee; the reduced amount is rounded half up to the cent.

**Reading the rule.**

| Program waives exchange shipping | Transfer distance versus free transfer distance | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | none owed |
| no | no more than the free distance | none owed |
| no | above the free distance | band fee of the full distance, less the program discount, rounded half up to the cent |

**Worked examples (hypothetical orders).**
- A Kestrel Certified replacement (free transfer distance 100 miles, discount 0 percent, no exchange waiver) with a transfer distance of 1450 miles falls in the third band: the fee is $1099.00.
- The same replacement at 80 miles is within the free transfer distance: no fee is owed.
- A Kestrel Value Line replacement at 500 miles falls in the first band, $499.00; at 501 miles it falls in the second band, $799.00.
- A Kestrel Premium Certified replacement at any distance: the program waives the exchange shipping fee, so none is owed.
